statusLine.command: input=$(cat); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); ctx_part=""; [ -n "$used" ] && ctx_part=" | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")%"; printf '%s@%s %s | %s%s' "$user" "$host" "$dir" "$model" "$ctx_part"
